text:
I made the voice-over, but I could not put it on your clip without changing the clip.

What I made:
- A warm, clear English narrator reading your words exactly: "Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress."
- No music and no captions.
- It is about 11 seconds long. It comes as an MP4 with a black screen, so only its sound track is useful.
- Download (link works for 24 hours): https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbihk1j04vhgq01sbc9b6u1/output.mp4?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T024052Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-
- Cost: 264 credits.

Why the merge failed: the tool that joins video and sound only takes videos made in Magic Hour. It turned down your uploaded file. None of my other tools can add a sound track to a video and leave every frame as it is.

What you can do:
1. Put the narration under your clip yourself. Any basic editor works (CapCut, iMovie, Clipchamp): place your clip, then drop the narration file under it. I don't know how long your clip is. If it is shorter than about 11 seconds, the narration will run past the end.
2. If your clip shows someone talking, I can lip-sync them to the narration. That changes their mouth movements, so the video would not stay exactly as it is. It also costs credits.

Tell me which one you want, or send the clip's length and I can make a shorter or longer read to fit it.
